description: The file defines a utility module 'VoiceWakeForwarder' for handling voice wake command forwarding, including transcript processing, error handling, and network communication with a gateway.

classes.name: VoiceWakeForwardError
classes.description: Represents error states for voice wake forwarding, including RPC failure with a message.

methods.name: prefixedTranscript
methods.description: Generates a prefixed transcript message including machine name info.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the transcript to a gateway with optional forwarding options.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if the gateway connection is active.
